Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear note and for sending Invoice_4392. We can absolutely work through a transitional arrangement. High level:

• VAT: we need either a VAT registration certificate for the invoicing entity or a signed confirmation of the UK subsidiary handling VAT (we’ll need the subsidiary’s VAT number to pass through tax correctly).

• Net terms / credit cap: we can offer a provisional Net45 for 90 days with a temporary credit ceiling. To get internal approval quickly I need your proposed cap (you suggested EUR 200k) and a short confirmation that purchase orders will reference the same legal entity on the invoice.

Optional: we can include an early‑pay discount if you convert to Net30 (1.25% invoice credit if paid within 10 days) — happy to table that with finance.

I’ll run this by our FP&A and legal to draft a short amendment; can you confirm the legal entity name for invoicing and whether you’ll provide a VAT certificate?

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the patience. Based on internal approvals we can proceed with the following short pilot amendment:

1) Terms: Redwood will move Helios Biotech to Net45 payment terms for an initial 90‑day pilot starting with invoice 4392.

2) Credit cap: A temporary credit ceiling of EUR 200,000 will be applied to Helios’s account for the duration of the pilot.

3) Conditions & documentation (required before pilot start):
  • Signed PO referencing the invoicing legal entity shown on the invoice.
  • Valid VAT registration certificate for the invoicing entity OR signed confirmation + VAT number for the UK subsidiary handling VAT.
  • Weekly AR sync for the duration of the pilot (15‑minute call).

4) Reversion & remedies: If two consecutive invoice cycles are paid late (beyond Net45) Redwood reserves the right to revert to Net60 and/or reduce the cap.

5) Early‑pay option: If Helios elects Net30 and pays within 10 days we’ll apply a 1.25% invoice credit for the pilot period.

We’ve prepared a one‑page amendment and DocuSign link to execute once you confirm the invoicing entity and attach the VAT certificate (or the UK subsidiary VAT number). I’ve attached the DocuSign placeholder (NetTerms_Amendment_DocuSign_link.txt) and referenced the invoice stub you sent.

Please confirm acceptance and attach the VAT cert when you have it. Once executed we’ll enable the cap and update billing.

Warmly,
Rachel
